annotations.text: First boot: sign in, then four steps. Step 2 takes the operator's OWN Kaggle token; step 3 the tunnel, because a Kaggle kernel accepts no incoming connections and the panel usually sits behind a router.

The strip under the tabs is the whole kernel lifecycle in one line: running / idle countdown / cold start. Voice shows the cold start after an auto-stop.

Kaggle's API has no stop endpoint, so the kernel times itself out and exits — the panel only asks it to.

Quota is the panel's own tally — Kaggle exposes no endpoint for hours left. Settings says so instead of pretending the number is authoritative.

Kaggle also runs its own notebook image, so the ComfyUI runtime ships as a mounted dataset rather than a container.
